answer: Written in a verbs first, step by step register, it stays short. Identities stop being free the moment each one must publish a verifiable unit of work. The horizon holds work receipts rather than names, so the signal of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread. The design leans on slash-on-divergence jury quorum, reset on any identity-link attempt, idle agents bleed standing. By the dawn of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up.
